node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal c2 (2,0,2) defect exclusion
node.closure: complete deletion of the diagonal (2,0,2) crossing-orbit row by reciprocal square vertices and the complete-source defect budget
node.statement: Every actual diagonal (a,b,c)=(2,0,2) packet contradicts the complete-source defect budget. The forced square common-K quartic and its reciprocal partner give two distinct doubled star vertices, costing defect two. The four remaining common-K quartics give eight reduced stars on at most six J_0 edges, costing at least two more. Thus total defect is at least four against budget three. This deletes the row in both source-subfield branches and with or without source ramification; four diagonal mixing rows remain.
